environment.tool: manual audit of the final tag source + live compiled binary; raw-socket client sending exact bytes, strict-token upstream peer logging verbatim request bytes and byte count

findings.description: The retry loop re-sends the request to the next upstream whenever attempt 1 fails, including when the failure happens after the upstream has already run the command. The attacker's split survives verbatim, so the second attempt executes again: two executions of a non-idempotent command from a single client request, with only attempt 2's output returned. The rebuilt target is byte-identical to attempt 1 apart from Host.
findings.title: A failed upstream that already executed the command is retried, so one request executes twice

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
methods: Control request first on the same config
Raw client bytes and raw upstream bytes captured in hex
Payload diffed against the control line
